intended_use: Decision support for research and teaching: multi-finding probabilities on chest radiographs (PA/AP). Not a diagnosis and not a tuberculosis screen.
training_data: TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121 'all' weights, trained on a union of public chest radiograph datasets. The exact union and labels are defined by the upstream project.
validation: No validation on Ugandan or local patients. Upstream public-dataset performance only; no local benchmark has been run (ml/benchmark has no chest benchmark yet).
limitations: Trained on non-African populations; performance may not transfer.
Labels are dataset annotations, not confirmed diagnoses.
Portable or scanned films and unusual windowing may degrade results.
The heatmap shows where the model looked, not proof of a finding.
MIAP does not screen for tuberculosis; a low score does not exclude TB.
intended_population: Adults and children with a chest radiograph; not validated for any specific population.
input: Single frontal chest radiograph, centre crop resized to 224x224, TorchXRayVision normalisation.
output: Per-finding probability scores with an uncalibrated threshold of 0.5 and a Grad-CAM.
ethical_notes: Decision support only. Clinician review is required before any action.
